name: Stanford Bunny
authoring: Remove 1113 unreferenced vertices and confidence/intensity scan fields.
Center referenced bounds and uniformly scale the longest axis to 1.6. Preserve all triangles and winding.
Generate area-weighted smooth normals; use a uniform material with zero UVs.
Export the canonical Mesh source and reference-only scene through Tools/author_bunny.py. Build independent Raster, Virtual and local BVH products offline.
